what_is_NOT_claimed: Nothing here is a claim about intelligence, understanding, awareness or suffering.
It is born mute: it speaks only through its diary (its readings and its self's account); no voice yet.
Ears self routing is weak (0.53 on strangers' sentences): what people say about it often lands elsewhere.
The self's only outside signal is the founder's read-back strikes; at founder pace it will say 'I don't know yet' about most regions for weeks to months.
The self is certified on simulated truth (record streams) and on real-body non-interference; whether real strikes look like the gate truth is not certified.
